title: Separating facts and evaluation: motivation, account, and learnings from a novel approach to evaluating the human impacts of machine learning (AI & SOCIETY 38(4))
rule_cited: §1 IN, stratified (third-party evaluator) + §2 methodology findings + §4 Gate 1 fails → Tier C
reason: Read in full: a peer-reviewed account of an evaluation framework developed in partnership with Underwriters Laboratories Inc., piloted at two workshops (Nov 2020, 52 participants across six domains; June 2021), whose Section 4 "Major findings" reports documented process facts about what the pilot did and did not achieve — methodology findings, which §2 admits and §4 Gate 1 places in Tier C.

findings.finding: Piloting the fact/evaluation-decoupled framework across six domains at the November 2020 workshop did not produce consensus goals and values for any domain, but did establish a proof of concept that, once domain goals and values are stipulated, the framework supports meaningful criticism of particular machine-learning systems.
findings.finding_quote: In our brief workshops, we were not realistically able to arrive at such a consensus. Instead, we demonstrated a proof of concept that, given such goals and values, we could make meaningful criticisms of particular machine-learning systems.
findings.institution: UL Research Institutes - Digital Safety Research Institute (DSRI)
findings.tier_reasoning: §4 Gate 1 fails: this is a framework/methodology write-up, not an empirical model finding, so Tier C and Action Trackable? is left BLANK. Tier A condition (1) fails (no empirical model finding); condition (2) fails (no company or model is named — the pilot used domain case studies); condition (3) fails (no concerning model result). Gate 2 is not reached.

findings.finding: The workshop pilot identified the negotiation of trade-offs between conflicting domain goals and values as the framework's principal unresolved obstacle, with participants' primary objection being that treating goals and values as aspirational omits the pursuit of profit.
findings.finding_quote: This tension surfaced as a major hurdle during our workshops.
